model.weights: U4 asymmetric group 128, FP16 scales; verified main IR MLP tensors
model.comparison_limit: Original Qwen IR checkpoint differs from the Swift/Huihui mixed-IQ GGUF baseline

method.primary_metric: Actual retokenized input tokens / first nonempty streaming text time, seconds
method.requests: Fresh generate calls; full decoded document retained
method.uncertainty: No confidence intervals; screening results and synthetic quality checks only

attention.threshold_1: All attention blocks retained. Kernel/cache layout/quantization rounding differ from ordinary paged attention; not bitwise-equivalence evidence.
attention.threshold_below_1: Approximate attention; threshold is estimated cumulative mass, not a fixed keep percentage. KV is preserved; decode uses full KV.
attention.mtp: Disabled in all XAttention experiments; current release MTP path disallows XAttention.

incomplete_runs.openvino-mtp-dq32: 96K interrupted after >337.3146 seconds without first text; not a completed throughput.
incomplete_runs.openvino-no-mtp-dq32-r2: 96K interrupted to change tuning direction after >71.6150 seconds; not a throughput result.

setup_errors_excluded: First MTP-off controller run passed float cache_size to an integer API; no model inference.
First quality controller invocation happened while the prior service was loading; slots returned HTTP 503 and no experiment was started.
source_provenance: New controller runs include executed source copies and hashes. Early scouting runs have saved config and runtime/model pins but do not all have complete source snapshots.
memory: Windows shared GPU memory counters do not alone prove VRAM paging. Samples cover part of each run, not guaranteed full-run peaks.
default_service: Original SYCL blocked-GDN + MTP, 0.0.0.0:5001; not replaced by experiment presets.
early_metadata_correction: Early MTP-off scout config files incorrectly label cache_budget_scope as combined_main_and_default_draft. MTP was off; actual scheduler fields are preserved and determine capacity. Later script fixes the label.

input_quality_suite.scoring: Strict first JSON answer, exact values and JSON types; format tracked separately. Compare matching retokenized full-input hashes.
input_quality_suite.renderer: Jinja2 3.1.6, unmodified native template; GenAI Minja cannot parse its is-undefined syntax.
